sources.claim: The 36-digit number is divisible by 9 (direct BigInt division) and its digit sums are 135 then 9
A number and its digit sum leave the same remainder on division by 9, because each power of ten is one more than a multiple of 9
sources.ref: elementary number theory; spot-checked in src/sims/puzzles.test.ts

post.caption:
Can you tell whether this 36-digit number is divisible by 9 without dividing?

Add its digits: 135. Add again: 1 + 3 + 5 = 9. So yes, it’s divisible by 9.

Why it works: 10 = 9 + 1, 100 = 99 + 1, 1,000 = 999 + 1, and so on. So every number equals a multiple of 9 plus its digit sum, which means it’s divisible by 9 exactly when its digit sum is.

The number was generated from a fixed seed, and we checked it by direct division.
